known_facts_book1: A jigsaw Fuddle of Fuddlecumjig, an easy puzzle to put together, who knits.
Is reassembled by the visitors and promises to knit new mittens for a kangaroo who lost hers.
Sits at the foot of the table at the merry Fuddle dinner.

not_in_this_book: Grandmother Gnit is made of bread

hallucination_signals: Grandmother Gnit is a bread woman

known_facts_book1: A bald fat jigsaw Fuddle, first name Larry, the chief personage of Fuddlecumjig.
Is missing a piece of his left knee, lost years ago when he scattered himself carelessly, so he limps.
Is pieced together by the visitors and sits at the head of the table at the Fuddle dinner.

known_relations_book1.Dorothy: One of the visitors who reassembles him.

not_in_this_book: the Lord High Chigglewitz is a rabbit
the Lord High Chigglewitz rules all of Oz

known_facts_book1: A leading bun citizen of Bunbury, made of bread and butter.
Debates stiffly whether the human strangers should be allowed to remain, fearing they will eat the townsfolk.

known_relations_book1.Dorothy: The human visitor the bun people fear.

not_in_this_book: Mr. Bunn is King of Bunbury

known_facts_book1: A bread citizen of Bunbury who takes Dorothy to get waffles from his back yard.
His wife is several shades darker than he is.
A living flour-sifter of Utensia, considered the holiest thing in the kingdom.
Serves as judge at King Kleaver's court when Dorothy is brought in as a prisoner.

known_relations_book1.King Kleaver: The ruler of Utensia he serves.
known_relations_book1.Dorothy: The prisoner over whose fate the utensils deliberate.

not_in_this_book: Judge Sifter sentences Dorothy to death

known_facts_book1: A richly dressed rabbit, named Bristle, who guards the gate of Bunnybury and admits visitors.
Demands Dorothy's letter of introduction from Ozma before letting her pass through the wicket.
Leads Dorothy in with pompous cries of 'Make way for Princess Dorothy' and promises to erect a statue of her.

known_relations_book1.Dorothy: The visitor he admits and escorts through Bunnybury.

not_in_this_book: the Keeper of the Wicket is King of Bunnybury
the Keeper of the Wicket bars Dorothy forever

hallucination_signals: the Keeper of the Wicket rules Bunnybury
the Keeper of the Wicket refuses Dorothy entry

known_facts_book1: A rabbit attendant in Bunnybury who serves the Rabbit King.
Announces the time and serves luncheon for the King and his visitor Dorothy on command.

known_relations_book1.Rabbit King: The Bunnybury monarch he waits upon.
known_relations_book1.Dorothy: The visitor for whom he serves luncheon.

known_facts_book1: A living cleaver, the King of Utensia, the kingdom of kitchen utensils.
His Spoon Brigade brings all prisoners before him, including Dorothy, Toto and Billina.
Sits up and questions Dorothy sharply when she is brought to his court.

known_relations_book1.Judge Sifter: The judge who serves in his court.
known_relations_book1.Dorothy: The prisoner brought before him by the Spoon Brigade.
